summary: Adela Cojab discusses her experiences as an activist on college campuses, the nature of indoctrination, and the importance of finding one's own way to support Israel. She also recounts her recent mission to Israel, where she visited Kfar Aza and heard firsthand accounts from survivors of the October 7th attacks.
